verdict.rationale: The IT, Digital & Cybersecurity practice page has a named section, "Protection for software, open source and databases," so open source is a documented area of the firm's tech IP work. However, the section's text only covers IP issues around new technologies and protecting digital assets. It does not mention license compliance counselling or drafting OSS usage policies for product companies. Missing for 10: explicit open-source license compliance advice (e.g. copyleft or audit work), OSS usage policy drafting, matter references or independent corroboration.
